page.title: Build your website in minutes | Oxira
page.description: Design a professional website with Oxira Studio: pick a design, describe your business, and edit it live with an AI designer. Hosting, domain, logo and support included.
page.lead: Pick a design, tell us about your business, and shape your website by chatting with our AI designer while you watch it change live. When you are happy, order it and our system takes it from there.
page.free: Designing is free. You only pay when you order.

steps.name: Choose a design
steps.text: Twelve professional designs, from companies and clinics to law firms, real estate, salons, contractors, schools and gyms.

steps.name: Tell us about you
steps.text: Your name, what you do and how to reach you. The AI writes your first version in seconds.

steps.name: Edit by chatting
steps.text: Ask for changes in your own words: colours, text, sections, language. See every change instantly.

steps.name: Order and launch
steps.text: Choose hosting, domain, logo and support. We publish your site and send you the details.

faq.a: Yes. The content, logo and domain are yours. If you leave, we hand over your files and transfer the domain to you.

faq.q: Do I need any technical skills?
faq.a: No. You describe what you want in your own words and the AI designer does the rest. Our team is there if you need help.

faq.q: Can I change my website after it goes live?
faq.a: Yes. Come back to Oxira Studio any time to edit it, or ask our support team.

faq.q: How long until my website is live?
faq.a: Usually the same day you pay. Saudi .sa domains take a few extra days because they need a commercial registration.

faq.q: What if I am not happy?
faq.a: You see your website before you pay, so there are no surprises. See our refund policy for the details.

faq.q: Can you build something bigger, like a store or an app?
faq.a: Yes. Choose the Business package or contact us for a custom project.

addons.body: Turn your website into a tool that brings customers. Add any service from your account at any time, monthly, cancel anytime.

menu.name: Digital menu & QR
menu.desc: A phone-friendly menu or price list with QR codes for tables and counters. Update prices yourself any time.

booking.name: Online bookings
booking.desc: Customers book a service and time from your website. You confirm from your account and they get email reminders.

reviews.name: More Google reviews
reviews.desc: A review page and printable QR card. Every customer sees the Google review button, and low ratings and comments also reach you by email.

chat.name: AI assistant
chat.desc: Answers visitors 24/7 from your website content and sends you their contact details when they want a call.

content.name: Monthly social content
content.desc: 12 ready posts every month, written for your business, with branded images to download.

tickets.name: Event tickets
tickets.desc: Sell tickets on your event website with online payment, QR tickets by email and check-in at the door.

seo.name: Google SEO — Basic
seo.desc: Search Console, monthly title and description suggestions you approve, a weekly health check and a monthly report.

seogrowth.name: Google SEO — Growth
seogrowth.desc: Everything in Basic, plus 4 articles and 2 local pages every month and a keyword plan. Nothing goes live without your approval.

social.name: Social media management — Basic
social.desc: 12 posts a month in your brand colours with a Saudi seasonal calendar, published automatically to Instagram and Facebook after you approve them, plus a monthly report.

socialpro.name: Social media management — Pro
socialpro.desc: Everything in Basic, plus 20 posts a month, 4 Reels scripts with covers, AI replies to comments and priority support.

ads.name: Ads management
ads.desc: A monthly ad plan for Instagram and Facebook that runs only after you approve it. You pay the ad budget to Meta directly, with a fixed spending cap, weekly results and a monthly report.
